I often change clothes to work out in the gym, or swim, in the middle of the day. Getting in and out of technical fabric workout gear or swimming trunks can be a struggle, especially if I am wet from swimming, sweaty from working out, or my skin is simply damp.

Now if I am changing after a swim, I will put my socks on even before taking off my swimming trunks, to keep them from getting tangled in my feet. Basically keeping socks on at all times, whether getting dressed/undressed, always helps with friction.
